name: Heavy Duty Axle Washers
description:
Heavy Duty Axle Washers, sharp cut teeth, force multiplying design and non-bending, heat treated, 4mm thick steel bodies, the perfect replacement axle washers for your Track Cycling hub.
- Force multiplier design increases the force applied by 30%.
- (3mm grip face Vs 4.5mm nut face.)
- Smooth Nut face reduces tightening torque friction.
- Sharp cut teeth 'bite' into any surface to provide maximum grip.
- 4mm thick hardened Cr-Mo steel body (resists bending.)
- 10.2mm clearance hole (fits 3/8" and 10mm axles)
- 20mm outer diameter grip-face (fits into most dropouts.)
- Black Oxide finish (suits most applications)
Sold in Pairs

name: Halo Rear Track Hub
description:
Extremely popular, light weight track hubs with super smooth Japanese sealed bearings and a hollow threaded steel axle.

Weights noted for track hubs include tracknuts at 32g

IMPORTANT NOTE:
These hubs must only be used with ISO standard 1.29" x 24tpi L/H fixed sprocket lockrings. Do not use French (1.32" x 24tpi) or Italian (33 x 1mm) standard lockrings. The larger diameter French and Italian lockrings may appear to work but eventually will strip the threads from the ISO hub.
